profile_text.body:
Kyndryl is a public company founded in 2021 and headquartered in New York, NY, USA. It trades under the ticker KD and is registered with the SEC as Kyndryl Holdings, Inc. Martin Schroeter is Chairman and CEO. On its own site, the company says it designs, builds, manages and modernizes the mission-critical technology systems that the world depends on every day.

The site's material centers on AI and modernization rather than named products. Kyndryl describes a 2026 People Readiness Report that it says reveals a decline in workforce readiness as AI adoption surges. It also references a Kyndryl Conversations episode in which Martin Schroeter speaks with Kyndryl Global Head of Strategy Kris Lovejoy about why modernization is becoming harder in the AI era, an Innovation Show x The Kyndryl Institute podcast on how AI is evolving business models, and commentary on resilience as AI accelerates attackers' capabilities. The company describes AI-native enterprises as creating conditions for continuous growth, efficiency and resilience by putting AI at the core of their business.

The record shows no tracked products, no MCP servers and no lawsuits. Kyndryl's law exposure is recorded in New York, with a count of 459.
